review_text: I used to come infrequently here to eat South Indian dishes. Now, they have decreased the alu masala portion in their ghee podi masala dosa, which I used to really like here. I don't expect a subpar portion when paying in triple digits for podi masala dosa. They could have increased the price slightly if money was the concern.
Good place, fast ordering and clean. Crispy dosa.
